schema.title: Online Document Flow Master Schema
schema.description: Master schema for online-flow instance data. Online renders a single document, notifies the parent contract-flow when render-ready, waits for the user's approval, then notifies approval and waits to be finalized by the parent.

documentId.description: Identifier of the document this instance renders

contractInstanceId.description: Parent (contract-flow) instance id, passed at start. Target instanceId for render-ready / approval-received DirectTrigger callbacks.

renderReady.description: DirectTrigger target on the parent for the render-ready notification.

approvalReceived.description: DirectTrigger target on the parent for the approval-received notification.

rendered.description: Whether the document has been rendered

approved.description: Whether the user approved the document
